extractionMethod.note: Read directly via pdftotext -layout across all 6 pages of the standalone Rack Rates PDF. Reservations are managed by a third-party operator, The Safari & Conservation Company (SCC) — T&Cs are SCC's, not Manda Bay's own.

structuralFindings: Base rate is PER PERSON PER NIGHT, Full Board equivalent — 'Standard Rate Details' confirms 'All meals during your stay' is INCLUDED in the base rate, unlike Lion in the Sun or Lantana where meal plan is a separate choice/supplement.

Four pricing seasons plus a CLOSED month: Low (Apr, Jun, Sep), Mid (Jul, Nov 1-Dec 19), High (Jan 7-Mar 31, Aug, Oct), Festive (Dec 20-Jan 6). Property is CLOSED entirely 1-31 May — flag this explicitly, no May bookings possible regardless of rate tier.

Three room categories: Garden Rooms, Palm Rooms, Beachfront Rooms — each with 4 rate columns (Per Adult Sharing, Single Room, Children Sharing Own Room 6-18, Extra Bed in Room Under 18). Garden Rooms have NO extra-bed option ('X') — double occupancy only due to room size.
Conservancy Fee is a ONE-TIME PER STAY charge (not per night) — $50/adult, $20/child, $0 under-5 — a distinct billing unit from every inland Soroi property's per-night mandatory fee.

Optional 'Safari Supplement' (effectively an All-Inclusive upgrade) is priced per person PER NIGHT: $300 adult, $150 child, $0 under-5. Includes house wines/spirits, one Lamu boat trip w/ guide + museum fee, water sports, snorkelling. Excludes all fishing, dhow excursions, cellar wines, premium spirits/cocktails. Explicitly 'non-commissionable.'

Child age brackets: 0-4 free; 5-17 = children's pricing; 18+ = adult pricing. Children sharing a TWIN room (6-18) get the 'Sharing Own Room' rate; a single child alone pays the single per-person rate, not a discounted rate. Max 2 extra beds for children with parents in Beachfront/Palm only (not Garden).
'2026 SPECIAL: Stay 6, Pay 5' applies to ALL rate types throughout 2026, EXCLUDING Festive season — a fixed-nights-free promotion rather than Soroi's percentage-based long-stay ladder.

Extensive priced 'Extras' menu exists (water sports, fishing, dhow excursions, Lamu excursions, guide accommodation, child care, yoga) — captured below for completeness since a full itinerary quote may need these.
Room inventory: 11 Beachfront, 5 Palm, 6 Garden. Room 7 (Palm) is a two-bedroom Family Cottage — worth knowing for family bookings.
Minimum stay: 2 nights standard, 5 nights over Christmas/Festive.
